name: Idle / Paused Splash Screen
author: Johnnie (keep-on-walking)
description: Shows a configurable splash on the HDMI output whenever no media is playing: centered text or a fullscreen image when idle, and an optional PAUSED frame when a playlist is paused. Writes directly to the framebuffer beneath FPP's video plane, so it appears instantly when playback stops and never conflicts with GStreamer/KMS output. Configurable from the dashboard (Content Setup > Idle Splash). No FPP core modifications required.
